title.en: California’s attorney general files suit against OpenAI
title.zhHans: 加州总检察长对 OpenAI 提起诉讼

searchSummary.en: California Attorney General Rob Bonta announced filing a lawsuit against OpenAI; OpenAI told TechCrunch the suit singled it out over an industry-wide challenge.
searchSummary.zhHans: 加州总检察长 Rob Bonta 宣布已对 OpenAI 提起诉讼；OpenAI 向 TechCrunch 表示，该诉讼就全行业共同面临的挑战单独针对它。

summary.en: On November 16, California Attorney General Rob Bonta announced filing a lawsuit against OpenAI; OpenAI told TechCrunch the suit singled it out over an industry-wide challenge.
summary.zhHans: 11 月 16 日，加州总检察长 Rob Bonta 宣布已对 OpenAI 提起诉讼；OpenAI 向 TechCrunch 表示，该诉讼就全行业共同面临的挑战单独针对它。

narrative.en: The filing is a procedural fact; the alleged safety failures remain unadjudicated. OpenAI disputes the focus of the lawsuit in its media response, not the filing itself.
narrative.zhHans: 起诉是程序事实，所指安全问题尚未经法院认定。OpenAI 在媒体回应中反对诉讼针对它的方式，并未否认起诉已发生。

text.en: On November 16, California Attorney General Rob Bonta announced filing a lawsuit against OpenAI.
text.zhHans: 11 月 16 日，加州总检察长 Rob Bonta 宣布已对 OpenAI 提起诉讼。

claims.notes: AG original establishes filing; TechCrunch directly reports OpenAI response. The complaint allegations and OpenAI defense are not adjudicated findings.

text.en: OpenAI told TechCrunch the suit singles it out over an industry-wide challenge; the alleged safety violations remain unadjudicated.
text.zhHans: OpenAI 向 TechCrunch 表示，该诉讼就全行业共同面临的挑战单独针对它；所指安全违规尚未经法院认定。

claims.notes: A separately reported OpenAI response and ongoing dispute, not independent proof that the complaint is true or false.
